meta.title: Suppliers: join in a minute · 1💗1
meta.description: A link to your site or one sentence about your business, your service area, and your supplier card is ready. No commission on direct contact, and customers looking for exactly you.

hero.title: Your card, ready in a minute
hero.sub: Give us your website, upload a catalog or photos, or tell us in a sentence what you do. We draft your card, you see it, and only then do you decide.

promises.p3: Nothing is published without your yes

form.urlHint: A site, landing page or business page. If we can't read it, describe it in words instead.
form.textLabel: What you do, for whom, and at what price
form.textPlaceholder: e.g. Event photographer in the north, weddings and bar mitzvahs, packages from ₪4,500 including an album…
form.areaHelper: Pick a point and a radius, or choose online. We'll only suggest you to customers you can reach.
form.filesPick: Choose files or take a photo
form.filesHint: PDF, Word or images, up to {{count}} files. Files are only read, never stored.
form.filesNotePlaceholder: e.g. prices include VAT, delivery in the north only…

loading.title: Drafting your card…
loading.sub: Reading what you sent and lining up services and prices. Up to half a minute.

preview.title: This is how your card will look
preview.noProducts: We found no defined services. You can add them in the next step.
preview.more: More items in the draft, to edit in the next step: {{count}}

contact.title: Almost there: who are you?
contact.sub: Next you can edit everything: services, prices, photos and area. The card is published only after you sign the agreement.
contact.name: Your name
contact.note: The next page is your full editor. Its link is valid for 24 hours, and at its end you open an account with this email.

errors.analyze: We couldn't read that. Try another address, or describe it in words.
errors.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time. Please try again in an hour.
errors.save: We couldn't save. Check your name and email and try again.
errors.files: We couldn't read the files. Try a PDF with text, a sharper photo, or describe it in words.
errors.filesTooLarge: The files are too large (15MB together at most).

other.title: Here for something else?
other.demand_t: What people near you are asking for
other.demand_d: People looking for the same thing join up, and you can make them one offer.
other.shop_d: Stock, orders, delivery and payment, on your own site or ours.
other.partnership_t: You want partners, not just customers
other.partnership_d: Say a photographer and a DJ selling one package and splitting the income by agreement.
other.order_d: Write what you need and suppliers make offers. That's the concierge.

about.title: Where are you stepping in?
about.lead: 1💗1 is not another supplier directory. It is a platform for partnerships by consent, and a one-person business has a place of its own here too.
about.card_t: Your card is your business here
about.card_d: Services, prices, photos and service area. You edit it, you decide what shows, and it all stays yours.
about.wishes_t: Customers who write what they need
about.wishes_d: In the concierge, people describe what they want and the platform breaks it into parts. A part that fits you and your area comes to you, from day one.
about.direct_d: A customer who contacts you directly is yours. No joining fee and no obligation to pay. Whoever wants to gives what they can.
about.together_d: When a customer needs several suppliers at once, say a photographer, a DJ and catering, you can offer one package and split the income. Every split is set by the consent of everyone in it.
about.grow_t: And if you like, partners too
about.grow_d: Your business here is a rikma: you can bring people into it, and every hour, resource or sum they bring becomes a share of ownership. Optional, and you can stay on your own.
about.safe: Nothing is published and no account is opened until you sign the agreement, at the end.
